title: GSD Run Dashboard Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task TDD implementation plan for a local Node/Express + React dashboard that tracks GSD project roadmaps, live agent activity, and git milestones.
notes: Document is structured as a step-by-step implementation/TDD plan (code, tests, commit steps) rather than a pure decision record or product requirements doc. Classified as SPEC because each task defines concrete module interfaces/data contracts (Produces/Consumes signatures, API surface, data shapes) that other components must honor; ambiguity resolved per the ADR>SPEC>PRD>DOC precedence rule since DOC (tutorial/step-by-step) signals were also present alongside the interface/contract signals.
